version_history.note: Mapping rows as drafted from plan v1.2.1 section 8.4.

Wave 5 stream 3. No mapping TARGET changed. What changed is that every row now carries (a) an effective window, (b) an explicit mapping_kind so that 'maps to nothing' can no longer be confused with 'not yet mapped', and (c) an evidence class naming the document that sources the raw literal. Rows whose raw spelling is not sourced are marked UNVERIFIED - REQUIRES ZOHO CONFIRMATION and are INACTIVE: the resolver refuses them and raises UNMAPPED_EXTERNAL_STATUS rather than applying an unsourced guess.

rule: Raw Zoho status values are stored VERBATIM and NEVER overwritten, in external_status_raw, alongside the product and API version that produced them. This registry maps them to a C3 business status. An UNMAPPED raw value never guesses: the record is accepted, the raw value preserved, and a reconciliation_exception of kind UNMAPPED_EXTERNAL_STATUS is raised. Same fail-closed philosophy as domain.lifecycle_permits.
product_separation_rule: Every mapping row names its product. A Books mapping is NOT evidence for an ERP mapping and must never be applied to one. The adapter selects the mapping set by integration_connection.product. There is no fallback between products and no product-agnostic row.
target_registry: C3_statuses.json - every maps_to value in this file must exist there. Enforced by a contract test.
provisional_note: ERP rows are marked provisional pending client decision D-14. Zoho ERP v3 is the provisional target; the client may be running Books + Inventory. Both mapping sets are maintained to the same standard.

mapping_kinds.BUSINESS_STATUS: maps_to names a C3 business status. The mirrored object's business status is set from it.
mapping_kinds.NO_BUSINESS_STATUS: A POSITIVE assertion, reviewed and deliberate: this raw value has no business-status meaning at all. maps_to is null BECAUSE nothing should be set, not because nobody has decided yet. An Inventory purchase receive in transit is the canonical case - it is operational, and rendering it as a document lifecycle label would misrepresent it.
mapping_kinds.ACCOUNTING_STATUS_ONLY: The raw value drives accounting_status (Draft | Approved | Void | Reversal) and NOT a business status. Bill status is the canonical case: accounting_status in {Approved, Reversal} is the accounting-effective set, preserved exactly from AUD-C-004.

coverage_kinds.COMPLETE_PER_VENDOR_SPEC: Every raw value the captured vendor specification documents for this (product, object, field) has a row. A value outside this set is a genuine surprise and must raise UNMAPPED_EXTERNAL_STATUS.
coverage_kinds.INCOMPLETE_UNVERIFIED: The value set for this (product, object, field) is NOT known. Rows here are partial or absent. This is 'not yet mapped' and is categorically different from NO_BUSINESS_STATUS. Every lookup against such a block that misses raises UNMAPPED_EXTERNAL_STATUS, and the block must be closed out in Phase 0B-2.

evidence_classes.DOCUMENTED_RAW_VALUE: The literal lowercase raw value appears in the captured vendor OpenAPI specification. Active.
evidence_classes.PLAN_APPROVED: The row is stated in section 8.4 of the approved implementation plan. Active.
evidence_classes.UNVERIFIED: The state is believed to exist (an endpoint implies it) but its raw literal spelling is not sourced anywhere available offline. INACTIVE - the resolver will not apply it.

unmapped_handling.action: accept the record, preserve external_status_raw verbatim, raise reconciliation_exception kind UNMAPPED_EXTERNAL_STATUS
unmapped_handling.never: guess a mapping, drop the record, or default to a business status
unmapped_handling.blocks: period close, and capitalisation, while OPEN
unmapped_handling.also_raised_when: the raw value matches a row that exists but is INACTIVE (unverified spelling) or outside its effective window. An inactive row is not a mapping; it is a note about work still to do.

registry_rules: Every mapping is data, versioned and effective-dated - never a hardcoded dict in application code.
Every maps_to value must exist in C3_statuses.json. Enforced by tests/test_contracts.py.

A null maps_to is NEVER an omission. It is either NO_BUSINESS_STATUS (a reviewed assertion that the value has no business meaning) or ACCOUNTING_STATUS_ONLY (it drives accounting_status instead). mapping_kind says which, and a row may not leave it unsaid.

'Maps to nothing' and 'not yet mapped' are different facts recorded in different places: mapping_kind on the row, coverage on the block. A block with coverage INCOMPLETE_UNVERIFIED and an empty rows list is not asserting anything about the field's meaning.

A row whose evidence class is UNVERIFIED must be inactive and must carry the marker string 'UNVERIFIED - REQUIRES ZOHO CONFIRMATION'. The resolver refuses inactive rows and raises UNMAPPED_EXTERNAL_STATUS, which is the same fail-closed behaviour as an absent row.
Rows marked verification_required cannot be relied upon until Phase 0B-2 confirms them against the tenant.
